<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Maximum power transfer worked example reduced to a Thevenin equivalent</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>

<line x1="250" y1="110" x2="250" y2="160" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="238" y="160" width="24" height="80" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="270" y="206.0" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">12 Ω</text>
<line x1="250" y1="240" x2="250" y2="290" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="250" y1="110" x2="290" y2="110" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="290" y="98" width="60" height="24" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="320.0" y="90" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2 Ω</text>
<line x1="350" y1="110" x2="370" y2="110" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="90" y1="226" x2="90" y2="290" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="90" y1="290" x2="370" y2="290" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="370" cy="110" r="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/><circle cx="370" cy="290" r="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="230" y="330" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Original network, load removed</text>
<line x1="405" y1="200" x2="455" y2="200" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<circle cx="540" cy="200" r="26" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="540" y="196" font-size="18" fill="#0f766e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">+</text>
<text x="540" y="218" font-size="18" fill="#0f766e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">−</text>
<text x="504" y="206" font-size="18" fill="#0f766e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">16 V</text>
<line x1="540" y1="174" x2="540" y2="110" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="540" y1="110" x2="570" y2="110" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="570" y="98" width="70" height="24" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="605.0" y="90" font-size="18" fill="#0f766e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Rth 6 Ω</text>

<rect x="708" y="160" width="24" height="80" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="740" y="206.0" font-size="18" fill="#b45309" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start"></text>
<text x="700" y="205" font-size="18" fill="#b45309" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">RL</text>
<text x="700" y="227" font-size="18" fill="#b45309" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">6 Ω</text>
<line x1="720" y1="240" x2="720" y2="290" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="540" y1="226" x2="540" y2="290" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="540" y1="290" x2="720" y2="290" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="610" y="330" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Thevenin form, matched load</text>
<rect x="40" y="360" width="720" height="180" rx="14" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="398" font-size="19" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Vth = 24 × 12 ÷ (6 + 12) = 16 V</text>
<text x="400" y="438" font-size="19" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Rth = (6 × 12 ÷ 18) + 2 = 4 + 2 = 6 Ω</text>
<text x="400" y="478" font-size="19" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pmax = 16² ÷ (4 × 6) = 256 ÷ 24 = 10.67 W</text>
<text x="400" y="518" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Load voltage 8 V, load current 1.33 A</text>
</svg>

figs.name: maximum-power-transfer-theorem-load-matching-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart for resistive, conjugate and magnitude load matching for maximum power
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing when to use RL equal to Rth, the conjugate load or a resistor equal to the source impedance magnitude, with the article example.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart for choosing the load for maximum power in DC and AC circuits</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Which Load Gives Maximum Power?</text>
<rect x="240" y="56" width="320" height="56" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="78.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reduce the network to</text>
<text x="400.0" y="102.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Vth and Rth or Zth</text>
<line x1="400" y1="112" x2="400" y2="132" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,134.0 550.0,180 400,226.0 250.0,180" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="175.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Is the source</text>
<text x="400" y="197.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">AC with reactance?</text>
<line x1="250" y1="180" x2="190" y2="180" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="220" y="168" font-size="17" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="20" y="140" width="170" height="80" rx="10" fill="#0f766e" stroke="#134e4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="105.0" y="174.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DC: set</text>
<text x="105.0" y="199.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">RL = Rth</text>
<line x1="400" y1="226" x2="400" y2="254" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="246" font-size="17" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<polygon points="400,256.0 550.0,304 400,352.0 250.0,304" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="299.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Can the load</text>
<text x="400" y="321.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">reactance be set?</text>
<line x1="250" y1="304" x2="190" y2="304" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="220" y="292" font-size="17" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="20" y="264" width="170" height="80" rx="10" fill="#0f766e" stroke="#134e4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="105.0" y="298.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">ZL = Rth − jXth</text>
<text x="105.0" y="322.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">conjugate</text>
<line x1="550" y1="304" x2="600" y2="304" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="575" y="292" font-size="17" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="600" y="264" width="180" height="80" rx="10" fill="#134e4a" stroke="#134e4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="690.0" y="298.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Resistor only</text>
<text x="690.0" y="322.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">RL = |Zth|</text>
<rect x="40" y="390" width="330" height="140" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="430.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Example, Zth = 3 + j4 Ω</text>
<text x="205.0" y="454.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Vth = 10 V rms</text>
<text x="205.0" y="478.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ZL = 3 − j4 Ω</text>
<text x="205.0" y="502.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Pmax = 10² ÷ 12 = 8.33 W</text>
<rect x="430" y="390" width="330" height="140" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#134e4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="595.0" y="430.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Same source, resistor only</text>
<text x="595.0" y="454.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">RL = |Zth| = 5 Ω</text>
<text x="595.0" y="478.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">I = 10 ÷ 8.94 = 1.118 A</text>
<text x="595.0" y="502.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">P = 1.118² × 5 = 6.25 W</text>
<line x1="105" y1="344" x2="160" y2="388" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="690" y1="344" x2="620" y2="388" stroke="#134e4a" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
</svg>
